rows.grounds: numeral referring to the eight siddhis
conjunction adding to the preceding list
fused form: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) joined with mūla-kaulam (root Kaula) by sandhi

items.question: What powers and attainment are identified with the root Kaula teaching?
premises: The eight powers are included in this enumeration.
The attainment of siddhis is named alongside them.
This attainment is identified as the root Kaula.
items.inference: The root Kaula encompasses the eight powers and the attainment of siddhis.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation within the fused compound siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ is somewhat compressed.
items.plain_english: And the eight, and the attainment of siddhis, are the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
